articles.summary: Plug has signed a 280-megawatt (MW) GenEco electrolyzer supply agreement with Arcadia eFuels for Project ENDOR in Denmark, together with a strategic cooperation agreement covering Arcadia's future projects. The agreement follows three years of joint engineering work, and deliveries will begin after the project issues notice to proceed.
articles.title: Plug and Arcadia eFuels Sign Strategic Partnership Covering More Than 1 GW of e-SAF Projects, Starting with 280 MW to Turn Danish Renewable Electricity into Jet Fuel

articles.summary: Today, on National Hydrogen & Fuel Cell Day, Plug is launching a new PlugPower.com, a website built to better reflect who we are today, where we are focused and the work happening across our business every day.
articles.title: Introducing a Redesigned PlugPower.com
